Name: New NPC Magpie 1.6
Author: muxuelaiyin
Description:
[size=2]你好，这里是鹊的非官方1.6更新，已获得原作者授权。

简介：

为你的星露谷新增一个叫做鹊的自订NPC，包括15个事件、200+新对话以及3个新菜谱，还有更多等你去探索。鹊暂住在哈维的诊所，他来自神秘的远东，之前是一名个人探险家。你觉得他看上去相当健康，但随着了解，你发现了他的秘密......

礼物喜好：

最爱：茶叶，绿茶，黄水仙，龙井虾仁，皮蛋瘦肉粥，糖醋鲤鱼
讨厌：一切垃圾和建材
喜欢：一切吃的，古物，矿物等
不喜欢：其他全民最爱的礼物比如五彩碎片等。但是你们可以送一个看看他的反应。

行程：

常规行程：8点起床，站在诊所的床边；10点前往博物馆开始工作直到下午4点，然后前往酒吧，待到9点回诊所，在床边玩手机直到11点睡觉
每周二：上午9点前往探险家公会，下午5点回诊所
每周三：上午照常，下午2点前往维克多家看书，下午6点回诊所
每周五：上午照常：下午2点前往维克多家借用他的电脑，下午5点回诊所
每周六：上午9点前往杂货店买东西，12点前往博物馆看书，下午4点回诊所，晚上9点睡觉
每周日：上午9点半在诊所治疗，下午2点前往卡洛琳的阳光房，8点回诊所
下雨：一整天都在诊所
夏季2号（生日）：上午10点前往海滩，晚上8点回诊所

好感事件：（注：都要看过上一个事件才能触发下一个）

0心：早上9点到晚上9点之间进入诊所
2心1：看过SVE版本的加入探险家公会事件后，当鹊在探险家公会时前往（事件增益：所有武器伤害量大幅提升）
2心2：不下雨时且鹊在镇上的时候进入小镇（事件收获：学会菜谱龙井虾仁。如果这次选项错过，那么可以等鹊8心好感时在格斯那里购买菜谱）
4心：下午5点到晚上11点之间进入酒吧
6心1：下雨时任意时间前往沙滩
6心2：任意时间进入探险家公会（领取任务：伤痕）
6心3：鹊在诊所的时候前往诊所，如果你在诊所以外的地方把任务物品交了，鹊会再给你，带着物品去诊所，无所谓鹊在不在（领取任务：神秘玉镯，把任务物品交给法师完成任务）
7心：上午9点到下午5点之间前往诊所
8心1：上午9点到下午5点间前往诊所
8心2：上午9点到下午5点间前往森林
8心3：上午9点到下午5点间前往海滩
8心4：上午9点到下午5点间前往北部山区（温泉那一块）
8心5：完成8心4自动播放
10心：天气晴朗时，上午9点到下午5点间前往森林
14心：天气晴朗时，在上午6点10分到下午5点间进入农舍[/size]

更加详细的介绍请前往：[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9832]Custom NPC Magpie(Que)[/url] 查看，再次感谢作者同意授权，感谢她创作出如此有趣美好的角色。

PS：
1.更新后，SVE不再是必需，但强烈建议你一起下载，因为鹊的背景故事是基于SVE的世界观展开的。
2.鹊的好感事件有很多分支，推荐下载[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8505]EVENT LOOKUP[/url]来重复体验。
3.高清肖像需要[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]作为前置，自行查找使用方法。
4.这个MOD现在应该与几乎所有MOD兼容，有任何问题请在评论区或者XHS给我留言，﻿我看到有空就会修。
5.如果你喜欢这个MOD，请在下载完成15分钟后返回主界面给我点个赞，拜托拜托。﻿
——————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————﻿
This MOD contains English translation, and the text comes from the original MOD. My English is very poor, so I am only responsible for merging it into the i18n file. If there are any translation errors, please do not report them to me as I am unable to resolve them. If anyone wants to create a more accurate translation, feel free to do so.

Gift Tastes:
love：Tea Leaves，Green Tea，Daffodil，Congee with Minced Pork and Preserved Egg，Longjing Shrimp，sweat and sour carp
Hate：Trash.Who the heck on the earth will like them.
Like：Food,crops,Artifacts and Minerals
Dislike：All the universal-loved things,like prismatic shard for example.But you can give one to him and see his reaction.

Schedule:
defalt：wake up at 8:00,go to ArchaeologyHouse at 10:00,work till 16:00 and then go to saloon,go back to hospital at 21:00,sleep at 23:00.
Every Tuesday：Go to AdventureGuild at 9:00,back to hospital at 17:00.
Every Wednesday：Things go to defalt befor noon，go to Victor's house at 14:00,back to hospital at 18:00.
Every Friday：Things go to defalt befor noon,go to Victor's house at 14:00,back to hospital at 17:00.
Every Saturday：Go to seedshop at 9:00，go to ArchaeologyHouse at 12:00，back to hospital at 16:00,sleep at 21:00.
Every Sunday：Stay at the hospital before noon,go to Caroline's sunroom at 14:00,back to hospital at 20:00.
rain：Stay at the hospital the whole day.
Summer 2（birthday）：Go to the beach at 10:00，back to hospital at 20:00.

Hearts Events:（ps：You have to see the previous event to trigger the next one）

0heart：Enter the hospital between 9 a.m. and 9 p.m
2hearts1：When you'd been a member of Adventurerguild,go to Adventurerguild when Magpie is there.(All weapons' harm would be rised after this event)
2hearts2：Enter the town when Magpie is there and it's not raining.（You will learn a new recipes after seen this event.If you chose the wrong choice and
missed it,you can still buy it from Gus when your rlationship with Magpie had reached 8hearts.）
4hearts：Enter the saloon between 17 p.m and 23 p. m
6hearts1：Go to the beach when it's raining.
6hearts2：Enter the Adventurerguild at anytime. （Add quest:scar）
6hearts3：Go to the hospital when Magpie is there.If you gave the quest object to Magpie outside the hospital ,he will give it back to you.Then you need to go
to the hospital with this object,otherwise you cannot start this event.（Add new quest：mysterious jade bracelet，found the wizard to complete it.）
7hearts：Go to the hospital between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m
8hearts1：Go to the hospital between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m
8hearts2：Go to the forest between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m
8hearts3：Go to the beach between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m
8hearts4：Go to the railroad between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m
8hearts5：Autoplayed after seen 8hearts4
10hearts：When the weather is sunny, go to the forest between 9 a.m. to 5 p.m
14hearts：When the weather is sunny, enter the farmhouse between 6:10 a.m. to 5 p.m

PS:
1.After the update, SVE is no longer necessary, but we strongly recommend downloading it together as the background story of Magpie is based on SVE's worldview.
2.Magpie's hearts events have many branches, and it is recommended to download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8505]EVENT LOOKUP[/url] to experience them repeatedly.
3.High definition portraits require  as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]﻿ a prerequisite,Please search for the usage method yourself.
4.This MOD should now be compatible with almost all MODs. If you have any questions, please leave me a message in the comment section or XHS, and I will fix it when I have time.
5.f you like this MOD, please give me a like on the main interface 15 minutes after downloading it, please. ﻿
6.Anyone who wants to translate this mod into other languages is welcome, and I would be extremely grateful.
